warnings: Manganese has a ceiling: US UL 11 mg/day (food + water + supplements); EFSA 2023 safe level 8 mg/day. ICMR TUL Not found.
ICMR 4 mg/day is a single value seen only through snippets (secondary, unverified); the 2019 FSSAI note traces 4.0 mg to ICMR 2010.
Labels may show compound weight, not elemental manganese: manganese sulfate monohydrate is 32.5% Mn, gluconate 12.3% (calc.).
Not for supplement suggestions in liver disease, cholestasis, parenteral nutrition, iron deficiency, pregnancy or breastfeeding without a doctor; requires doctor input.
Occupational exposure (welding, mining, battery or steel work) and high-manganese borewell water add to intake: BIS acceptable limit 0.1 mg/L; WHO provisional 0.08 mg/L.
Tea, besan, oats, kabuli chana and packaged foods have no IFCT manganese value: show approximate, never zero.
Tremor, stiffness, slowed movement or new mood or memory change with these risks: see a doctor.
